links.outcome: Match of OncoDoc2 recommendations from LLM inputs versus clinician gold standard
links.effect: Best LLM combination reached 75.57% accuracy on question answering, but only 16.67% of OncoDoc2 recommendations based on LLM inputs matched the gold standard.
links.quote: However, this approach yielded poor results as a CDSS, with only 16.67% of the recommendations generated by OncoDoc2 based on LLM inputs matching the gold standard.

unlisted_practices: Comparing prompt engineering techniques (zero-shot, enhanced zero-shot) to improve LLM accuracy in guideline-based decision support

screen.reason: Evaluates LLMs answering CDSS questions from breast cancer patient summaries across different prompt engineering techniques to test viability for clinical decision support.
